notes: Existing live-eval fixture (FLAT_ETA). The ETA is folded into to_date (prompt rule), 18:00 Europe/London on the reference day in BST = 17:00Z. Must not be over-segmented.
description: A signal failure between Reading and Basingstoke is causing delays of up to 20 minutes. Normal service is expected to resume from 18:00.

notes: Golden-corpus 'clearly resolved': explicit statement that the fault is fixed and service is normal.
summary: Points failure at Woking - now resolved
description: Following an earlier points failure at Woking, all lines have now reopened and trains are running normally. The fault has been fixed.

notes: Golden-corpus 'residual-only': root cause fixed, knock-on delays continue.
summary: Disruption between Clapham Junction and Wimbledon
description: The signalling fault between Clapham Junction and Wimbledon has now been fixed. Trains are still being delayed by up to 15 minutes while services return to normal.

notes: Negation pair ('has now ended'): the cause is over, cancellations continue -> residual, not resolved.
description: The strike action by members of the RMT union has now ended. Services are returning to normal but some early morning trains remain cancelled.

notes: Negation pair ('not expected to end soon'): must stay ongoing; 'lines are blocked' -> blocked_or_suspended.
summary: Broken down train between Haslemere and Guildford
description: Disruption caused by a broken down train between Haslemere and Guildford is not expected to end soon. Lines are blocked and trains are unable to run between these stations.

notes: Negation pair ('disruption which began at 18:00'): 18:00 is the start, so to_date must stay null. from_date is left unscored (a start time with no date is a judgment call).
description: Disruption which began at 18:00 due to a trespass incident near Surbiton is causing some trains to be cancelled or delayed by up to 30 minutes.

notes: Negation pair ('expect disruption until 18:00'): an ETA -> to_date 18:00 BST = 17:00Z on the reference day.
summary: Emergency engineering work between Basingstoke and Winchester
description: Expect disruption until 18:00 while emergency engineering work takes place between Basingstoke and Winchester. Some lines are closed and trains may be cancelled or delayed.

notes: GMT-season ETA (15:00 GMT = 15:00Z) and a diversion with no bus substitute.
description: Trains between Guildford and Woking are being diverted via Aldershot because of a landslip near Worplesdon. Journeys will take up to 20 minutes longer. The line is expected to reopen at 15:00.

notes: Golden-corpus 'schedule window narrower than validity' (the design doc's Woking-Basingstoke nights example, given explicit dates). Start = Monday 19 October 00:00 BST. to_date is unscored: whether 'Thursday night' ends at Friday 00:00 or 06:00 is a judgment call.
summary: Buses replace trains between Woking and Basingstoke overnight
description: From Monday 19 October to Thursday 22 October, rail replacement buses will operate between Woking and Basingstoke each night from 22:00 until 06:00 while engineering work takes place.

notes: Existing live-eval fixture (TRAP): three stations under one shared date range must stay ONE period. Ticket office hours are not a train-service schedule window, so schedule_window is unscored.
summary: Reduced ticket office hours at three stations
description: From Monday 4 May to Friday 26 June, ticket office opening hours will be reduced at Basingstoke, Woking, and Farnborough stations. Ticket offices at all three stations will open at 08:00 instead of 06:00 and close at 18:00 instead of 20:00 for the duration of this period.

notes: Existing live-eval fixture; the multi-period design's own expectation: 2 periods (one per date range), each with the same Monday-Thursday 11:00-14:00 window. Inclusive end days -> following midnight BST. impact_type accepts null or no_scheduled_service (trains run but skip the station one way).
description: Monday 11 May to Sunday 26 July: Platform 2 at Wandsworth Town is closed. Trains will call at platform 1 during this period. Monday - Thursday between 11:00 - 14:00: No trains travelling from London Waterloo will call at Wandsworth Town. Passengers for Wandsworth Town should circulate via Putney. Monday 27 July to Sunday 11 October: Platform 3 at Wandsworth Town is closed. Trains will call at platform 4 during this period. Monday - Thursday between 11:00 - 14:00: No trains travelling towards London Waterloo will call at Wandsworth Town. Passengers for Wandsworth Town should circulate via Clapham Junction.

notes: Existing live-eval fixture (BARRHEAD_DUMFRIES): two date ranges x three legs = 6 periods, per the period-cap remediation design. Windows use the prompt's 00:00-23:59 whole-day convention. Note the prompt's own worked example writes these dates as 00:00Z, ignoring BST; gold follows the prompt's stated rule (3), so a model copying the example scores off_by_1h.
summary: Buses replace trains between Barrhead and Dumfries
description: From Saturday 29 August to Friday 11 September, buses replace trains between Barrhead and Kilmarnock / Dumfries. Monday to Saturday during this period, buses operate between Kilmarnock and Troon, where passengers can connect with trains to / from Ayr. No scheduled services operate between Kilmarnock and Ayr / Stranraer on Sundays. From Saturday 12 September to Sunday 13 September, buses replace trains between Barrhead and Kilmarnock / Carlisle. On Saturday during this period, buses operate between Kilmarnock and Troon, where passengers can connect with trains to / from Ayr. No scheduled services operate between Kilmarnock and Ayr / Stranraer on Sunday.

notes: Existing live-eval fixture (IMPACT_BUS_NOSERVICE): one shared date range, a Saturday bus leg and a Sunday no-service leg -> 2 periods with different impact types.
summary: Buses replace trains between Kilmarnock and Ayr
description: From Saturday 29 August to Sunday 13 September, engineering work is taking place between Kilmarnock and Ayr. Buses operate between Kilmarnock and Troon, where passengers can connect with trains to / from Ayr, on Saturdays. No scheduled services operate between Kilmarnock and Ayr / Stranraer on Sundays.

notes: Clocks go back on Sunday 25 October 2026: period 1 starts at BST midnight (23:00Z) but ends at GMT midnight (00:00Z). Period 2's evening-only window is left unscored (21:00 to end of service has no single right end_time).
summary: Buses replace trains between Bournemouth and Weymouth
description: Saturday 24 October to Sunday 25 October: no trains will run between Bournemouth and Weymouth. Buses replace trains. From Monday 26 October to Friday 30 October, trains between Bournemouth and Weymouth will be cancelled after 21:00, with buses replacing them.

notes: Existing live-eval fixture (NORWOOD_JUNCTION). Whether the undated diversion aside earns its own period is an open design question, so segmentation is deliberately unlabelled: only completion is scored (consistency still is, with repeats).
summary: Buses replace trains via Norwood Junction
description: Monday to Thursday overnight, buses will replace trains between the affected stations via Norwood Junction. Some trains will be diverted via an alternative route.
